description: Local-first productivity app for tasks, goals, Pomodoro sessions, bookmarks, and prayer times.
notes: Uses the official Velopack Windows Portable ZIP generated from the self-contained win-x64 publish; the main executable is Jamrah.exe.
Jamrah includes a Velopack updater. Prefer 'scoop update jamrah' for Scoop-managed version changes so Scoop's installed-version metadata remains synchronized.
On Windows, the default application data directory is Documents\Jamrah and can be changed in the app's storage settings; no Scoop persist directory is required.
